title: Al-Burooj 85:1-4 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: At-Tariq 9 to 17, Al-Burooj 1 to 11 and stopping signs
source: Written for quran/y5 lesson 35 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Burooj 85:1-4 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 35. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ (١) وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ (٢) وَشَاهِدٍۢ وَمَشْهُودٍۢ (٣) قُتِلَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ (٤)

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Burooj 85:1-4 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 85:1-4 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 85:1-4 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Find the madd in 85:2 and say how long it is when we stop.
questions.a: «ٱلْمَوْعُودِ»: the waw before the last letter is 'aarid at the stop: 2, 4 or 6 counts.

questions.q: Who were 'the companions of the trench' (85:4)? Answer in one sentence.
questions.a: People who harmed believers only because they believed in Allah; Allah condemned them.

questions.q: Al-Burooj begins with an oath by ...
options: the sky with its great stars
questions.a: A) the sky with its great stars. 85:1: 'By the sky containing great stars.'

questions.q: Al-Burooj 85:1: «وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Allah swears by the sky with its great stars (85:1). What do you see when you look at the night sky?
questions.a: Stars in patterns, the moon, maybe planets: all signs of Allah's power and order.
